critical_code_review_comments: server.py now 1933 lines — splitting by domain (investments/etoro/projects/report) still recommended for maintainability

etoro_sync endpoint has no rate-limit guard against rapid user clicks (relies on upstream 429 handling + 60/min quota); consider a per-user 'syncing' lock to prevent concurrent in-flight requests from double-mutating investments collection

etoro_get retries up to 4 times on 429 with 2^n+random backoff capped at 30s — fine, but the final raise message mentions 'rate limit exceeded' even if the loop exits for other reasons (minor cosmetic)
investment_worth_aud and PIN redaction correctly include 'crypto' alongside 'shares' at every entry point (list/dashboard/report)
